AGENDA

  OF AN ADJOURNED MEETING OF

  THE CITY OF LA VERNE

  CITY COUNCIL

 Tim Hepburn, Mayor  www.cityoflaverne.org
  (909) 596-8726 - Phone
 Robin Carder, Mayor Pro Tem
  (909) 596-8740 - Fax
 Muir Davis, Council Member
  City Hall Council Chamber
 Wendy M. Lau, Council Member
  3660 D Street
 Rick Crosby, Council Member
  La Verne, CA 91750

  Monday, June 15, 2020 - 4:30 p.m.
  TELECONFERENCE NOTICE

Consistent with Executive Order N-29-20 to minimize the spread of the COVID 19 Virus, in-person participation by
the public will not be permitted and no physical location from which the public may observe the meeting will be
available. However, the City would encourage public participation in the public portion of the meeting and as
such want to make residents aware of the following opportunities on how to participate:

 1. View the meeting live through the City’s website at www.cityoflaverne.org and following the link titled
  “Council Meeting Live Stream” or on YouTube at www.cityoflaverne.org/youtube.

  2. For individuals that wish to share their comments before the meeting, you may email the Assistant City
  Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org by 12:00 pm, the day of the meeting with a phone number and the
  item(s) you wish to speak on. We will call you back at the appropriate time during the meeting for your
  comment.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a modification or
accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726
at least 24 hours prior to the Special Meeting and at least 48 hours prior to a regular City Council Meeting.
Regular Meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Monday of every month.

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

3.  ROLL CALL:  Council Member Lau, Council Member Crosby, Council Member Davis,
  Mayor Pro Tem Carder, and Mayor Hepburn.

  .
 AGENDA, La Verne City Council Adjourned Meeting, June 15, 2020, Page 2

4.  2020-21 CITY BUDGET - The purpose of this adjourned meeting is for the La Verne City Council
  to meet in a study session to review and conceptually approve the 2020-21 budget.

  a.  Overview & Presentation of the 2020-21 Fiscal Year City Budget in the amount of
  $58,627,295 by City Manager Robert Russi.

  b.  Presentation of City Departmental Budgets

  1.  Budget Sections 1-3 - General Administration, City Clerk, City Manager,
  (Includes Personnel & Risk Management, Finance, and Information Systems) -
  Presentation by the Personnel Officer JR Ranells, Interim Finance Director Mark
  Alvarado and Assistant City Manager Dan Keesey.

  2.  Budget Section 4 - Community Development Department - Presentation by the
  Director of Community Development Eric Scherer.

  3.  Budget Section 5 - Fire Department - Presentation by the Interim Fire Chief Devin
  Leonard.

  4.  Budget Section 6 - Police - Presentation by Police Chief Nick Paz

  5.  Budget Section 7 - Community Services Department - Presentation by the
  Director of Community Services Bill Aguirre.

  6.  Budget Section 8 - Public Works Department, (Includes Water, Streets, Fleet
  Maintenance, Building Maintenance & Parks) - Presentation by the Deputy
  Director of Public Works Anthony Ciotti.

  7.  Budget Sections 9-10 - Overview of Major Capital Improvements, Capital
  Equipment Outlay and Special Programs - Presentation by the Assistant City
  Manager/Public Works Director Dan Keesey, and the Deputy Director of Public
  Works Anthony Ciotti.

  Staff Recommendation:  Minute motion to conceptually approve the La Verne
  City budget is appropriate. A Resolution for the formal
  approval of the City budget will be scheduled for the
  June 15, 2020, City Council Meeting.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - This is the time set aside for anyone
  wishing to address the City Council on items not listed in any other place on the agenda.
  Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the legislative body is prohibited from talking or
  engaging in discussion on any item not appearing on the posted agenda. However, your
  concerns may be referred to staff or set for discussion at a later date. There is a three-
  minute limit per speaker. Please email cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org before 12:00 pm on the day
  of the meeting with your public comments.

6.  ADJOURNMENT
 AGENDA, La Verne City Council Adjourned Meeting, Monday, June 15, 2020, Page 3
